metadata.framework: Flask (GangaGUI gui + internal apps; CLI: optparse; Ganga 8.4.2)
notes: All 111 source and 907 sink candidate ROWS from extraction/sources.csv and extraction/sinks.csv were processed; 16 exact duplicate rows (identical file+line+node+callable+flowKind+argIndex, CodeQL decode artifacts) were removed keeping the first occurrence, leaving 1002 unique candidates labeled in 13 stable batches (S1-S6 sources, K1-K7 sinks), ids src-001..src-102 and sink-001..sink-900 in deduplicated CSV order. The removed rows are preserved in labels_raw_pass1.json.

Dedup: 16 duplicate rows removed by file+line+node+callable+flowKind+argIndex (9 source, 7 sink); 0 rows excluded otherwise - all 1002 unique candidates appear in entries with grounded labels, nothing silently dropped.

Trust model: the Pass 1 attacker is the HTTP client of the two GangaGUI Flask apps - the authenticated gui app (login_required) and the UNAUTHENTICATED internal API bound to localhost (APIServerThread, GangaGUI/start.py:99/:109, reachable by any local process and by remote drive-by cross-origin GETs since the write/read happens server-side). os.getenv/os.environ.get reads (16 source rows) and the optparse CLI/env config channels are operator/deployment trust and labeled none/fp; job/template filter params never reach filesystem paths.

Confirmed Pass 1 chains (all steps read in the real source): (A) CWE-22 read: /job/<int:job_id>/browse/<path:path> -> job_browse path param (gui/routes.py:639, source/tp) -> os.path.join(job_base_dir, path) (:659, summary/tp) -> exists/isfile (:665/:670, sink/tp) -> send_file (:671, sink/tp primary) / listdir (:676, sink/tp). (B) CWE-22 read+write: /storage/<path:path> -> storage_page path param (:925, source/tp) -> join(STORAGE_FOLDER, path) (:934, summary/tp) -> send_file (:975) / listdir (:980) / and via join(abs_path, secure_filename(filename)) (:954, summary/tp) -> storagefile.save (:955, sink/tp write - the DIRECTORY component is unsanitized). (C) CWE-22 write: /internal/jobs/<id>/export?path= (api/routes.py:223, source/tp) -> GPI export/stripped_export (Persistency:35/:41, summary/tp) -> fullpath (:140, summary/tp, abspath WITHOUT containment) -> open (:85, sink/tp write). (D) CWE-22 read: /internal/load?path= (api/routes.py:977, source/tp) -> GPI load (Persistency:154, summary/tp) -> getScriptPath (Runtime.py:28, summary/tp) -> open (Persistency:190, sink/tp read; content then eval'd at :209).

Sanitizers: secure_filename (gui/routes.py:953) is the ONLY confirmed (tp) sanitizer - concrete neutralization of the uploaded FILENAME component only; the DIRECTORY component (route path) stays tainted, so it must be emitted as an isBarrier on the secure_filename call node ONLY (the surviving write traversal does not pass through that call). allowed_file (:1799) is REJECTED (sanitizer/fp): an extension allowlist applied only to the fixed-path loadfile/runfile channels. No resolve()/realpath containment, no startswith(base) check, no '..' rejection, no relative_to/basename extraction exists anywhere on the confirmed chains.

Symlinks: no symlink creation or link-following policy exists on any confirmed chain, and the job/storage roots are not attacker-writable via the audited flows; symlink/TOCTOU not applicable on the GUI chains (recorded as not observed). The exists(:665/:969)/isfile (:670/:974) -> send_file/save sequences are separate syscalls (TOCTOU shape) but both sides of each race are already attacker-reachable in the confirmed chains, so it adds no new label.

Archive extraction residual risk (manual-review point): 6 tarfile extractall sites without filter= (Sandbox.py:154, WNSandbox.py:71, GaudiExecMerger.py:226, job_tools.py:310/:322, SAGAWrapperScript.py:87 outside the CSV scope) unpack ganga-produced/worker-produced tarballs (member names basename-sanitized at creation, Sandbox.py:92-94/:109); the HTTP-request attacker has no channel into these archives - backend/grid compromise is outside the Pass 1 request model. Labeled none/fp at 0.7 with the residual risk recorded.

Pass 4 carry-overs (manual-review points for the pass-4 round): /internal/runfile?path= (api/routes.py:1001, source/fp) -> runpy.run_path (GPIFunctions.py:119) executes any local file; load() evals file content (Persistency:209); the runfile-data/edited-job-info/config-data form channels write attacker content into fixed paths that are then executed/evalled/re-read as config (gui/routes.py:374/:375, :604/:606, :272/:274). One source/candidate row (gui/routes.py:1258 job_action request.json) is kept unconfirmed: the dynamic getattr/setattr dispatch over Job schema attributes cannot be tracked at AST level.

Phase 2 generation note: render only classification=tp entries into MySources/MySinks/MySummaries. Required MySummaries taint steps: os.path.join (any tainted argument -> result; the '/'-joins of both browser flows at gui/routes.py:659/:934/:954 are StrJoin nodes not covered by AST extraction), Persistency export/stripped_export/fullpath/load (param -> open argument), and Runtime.getScriptPath (param -> return). The secure_filename call node (gui/routes.py:953) is the only isBarrier; MySanitizers must NOT include allowed_file.

Labels grounded in the real ganga_vuln source tree (Ganga 8.4.2, database creation sha 0c0f9e33): all GangaGUI, Persistency, GPIFunctions, Runtime, files, Sandbox, WNSandbox, GaudiExecMerger and job_tools rows were read directly in this session; core/plugin family rows were verified by module-role analysis with spot-reading of representative sites (FileWorkspace, File, GangaRepositoryXML, Grid, bootstrap, Config, feedback_report, DiracUtilities, Athena, Batch, Condor, GaudiExec, LocalFile, SessionLock, ...) plus the Step-1 first-hand exploration inventory (detection.json).

No PyVul ground truth, patch diffs, CVE publications, or the vulnerability reports present in the source-tree root (GANGA-VULNERABILITY-REPORT.md, GANGA-CVE-REPORT-STORAGE.md, path_traversal_sinks.csv) were consulted; independent labeling only. Source tree, CodeQL database, Augur installation, and the Phase 1 CSVs were not modified.

entries.rationale: AfsToken.py:135: getenv reads operator/deployment environment configuration (KRB5CCNAME). Environment variables are operator-trust values, not request-boundary data: the Pass 1 attacker model for ganga is the HTTP client of the GangaGUI Flask apps (the authenticated gui app and the UNAUTHENTICATED localhost-bound internal API), and no environment variable in this codebase is influenced by request data. The value flows only into credential/proxy path defaults (X509_USER_PROXY, KRB5CCNAME), GUI port selection, HOME/USER expansion, or the GANGA_CONFIG_FILE config-file selection. references/python.md section 3 qualifies env vars as a source family only 'in security-sensitive flows'. Labeled none/fp for Pass 1.

No filesystem path is derived from the value. Labeled none/fp for Pass 1.

api/routes.py:223: save_path = request.args.get('path') inside job_export, the handler of @internal.route('/internal/jobs/<job_id>/export') (api/routes.py:212-:227). The internal Flask app has NO authentication on any route and is bound to localhost (APIServerThread('GangaGUIAPI', 'localhost', port) at GangaGUI/start.py:99/:109), so the value is controlled by any local process and by a remote drive-by page issuing a cross-origin GET (the export executes server-side regardless of the same-origin policy blocking the response). Trackable chain, every step in real code: save_path (:223) -> export(jobs(job_id), save_path) (:227) -> GPI export (GangaCore/GPIDev/Persistency/__init__.py:35, summary/tp) -> stripped_export (:41, summary/tp) -> fullpath = abspath(expandvars(expanduser(filename))) (:149-:150, summary/tp - normalization WITHOUT containment) -> open(filepath, mode) (:85, sink/tp - arbitrary file WRITE, mode 'w'/'a'). abspath collapses '..' but confines to nothing. Confirmed source for Pass 1 (CWE-22 write channel).
evidence: GangaGUI/start.py:95-109 (APIServerThread localhost bind, no auth on internal routes)
